summary: Masarykův onkologický ústav (MOÚ) posted this hackathon challenge asking for a tool that lets physicians write structured radiology reports directly in the hospital information system using smart templates. The stated benefits are faster and more accurate reports, better communication between doctors and collection of parametric data at the moment the report is written.

summary: Masarykův onkologický ústav (MOÚ) posted this hackathon challenge, stating that extracting data from oncology documentation is currently slow and demanding. It asks for an AI assistant that quickly finds key facts in medical reports, offers clear filtering and prepares pre-filled forms, so documentation staff make fewer errors and registries, research and clinical practice get better data.

summary: Masarykův onkologický ústav (MOÚ) posted this hackathon challenge, stating that patients currently have to hunt for preventive programmes on their own. It asks for a web application that uses a questionnaire to propose personalised examinations, finds free appointment slots and assembles one optimal plan, giving patients clear instructions and the hospital more efficient scheduling.

It asks for an AI tool that recognises key data in the summary, converts it into the correct codes and offers them to coders for validation.

summary: Hlas onkologických pacientů and AstraZeneca posted this hackathon challenge on soft-tissue sarcomas, rare connective-tissue tumours of which the card says roughly 400–600 new cases are diagnosed in the Czech Republic each year. It describes a serious, often aggressive disease that usually presents as a painless, growing lump and stresses that fast, accurate diagnosis is critical; the card's description is cut off before the specific ask.

It also asks for the system to measure communication effectiveness, such as who opened and understood a message.

summary: Fakultní nemocnice Brno posted this hackathon challenge, stating that facial-nerve palsy has serious functional, aesthetic and psychosocial effects and that existing severity-scoring systems depend on the assessing physician's subjective judgement and poorly capture small changes over time. It asks for an application that automatically recognises flaccid or spastic palsy from a short video.

It asks how to make that movement smooth and safe while sparing public space and the environment.

It asks how the city can become more resilient to climate extremes and better protect its people and public spaces.

title: Cirkulární město — Prague asks how to prevent waste and ease reuse, sharing and sorting

It asks how to prevent and reduce waste and make sorting, sharing and reuse easier for residents.

title: Úsporné a chytré budovy — Prague challenge on making city buildings more energy-efficient
summary: The City of Prague (MHMP, OICT) sets a hackathon challenge in its energy-and-buildings track: how municipal buildings can be more economical, smarter controlled and more efficient in energy consumption. title: Lokální a čistá energie — Prague challenge on producing and sharing local renewable energy
summary: The City of Prague (MHMP, OICT) sets a hackathon challenge in its energy-and-buildings track: how to support the production, sharing and use of local renewable energy and bring its benefits closer to residents. It evidences the city's stated interest in local energy self-sufficiency and stability.
